# Research

My work centers on affective polarization: how to conceptualize it as a genuinely affective phenomenon, how to measure it well in multi-party democracies, how it emerges as young people come of age politically, and what to do about it. A full list, including talks, is in my [CV](cv.qmd); on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=B0EWNtMAAAAJ&hl=nl&oi=ao) and [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0009-1049-7157).
